# lernapps.net tooling

> The tooling for building, checking and listing learning apps for lernapps.net with an AI assistant: the CLI
> `lernapps` (create, check and update an app), the plan template that holds the workflow, the skills with the rules, the
> rule catalog, the schemas and the review procedure. It is installed from git; it is not on npm.

## Quick path

1. Start the plan: download the [plan template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/plan-template.md) into the app's folder as `.vibe/plans/01-<short name>.md`, complete and unchanged, and read it there. It holds the whole workflow, from the first question to the listing, and names each command when it is needed. Follow it exactly.
2. Install the skills with `npx skills add lernapps/tooling`, then load the [skill lernapps-app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/SKILL.md) from the installed files.

Read every file this page links to in full and word for word: download it, then read the downloaded file. A fetch tool that summarises, shortens or translates a page loses its tasks, checkpoints and rules: never work from such a summary.

Everything here is also in the package `@lernapps/tooling`.

## Other llms.txt of lernapps.net

- [lernapps.net](https://lernapps.net/llms.txt): the vision and the overall picture.
- [Docs](https://lernapps.net/docs/llms.txt): the platform and organisation docs, and how to read them (biz42, pdt42 and their CLIs).
- [Apps](https://lernapps.net/apps/llms.txt): listing an app in the catalog.

## Commands

Every command lists its options with `--help`: `npx lernapps check --help` in an app, or
`npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main create --help` before the app exists.

- Create an app: `npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main create --archetype <archetype> [<dir>]`, then `git init` if needed and `npm install`. Needs git, github.com, codeload.github.com and the npm registry.
- Check an app: `npx lernapps check` in an app from the generator, the same as its git hooks and CI. Without a flag it runs everything; `--pre-commit` and `--pre-push` run one part.
- Check a built app or an app on the web: `npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main check <dir|url>`, for an app built any other way. Add `--entry <file>` to check a catalog entry against the app.
- [Publish an app](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling/blob/main/actions/app-publish/action.yml): a push to `main` runs the generated workflow `Pages`; its job `deploy` publishes the checked bundle to the app repo's GitHub Pages (branch `gh-pages`, served from its root) and prints the address: the developer's own, usually `https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/`; only a repo of the lernapps organisation is served below lernapps.net. Any other host works too; the catalog entry links to the app wherever it lives. If it fails, its message says what to fix.

## Guidance

- [Plan template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/plan-template.md): the workflow of an app's first version (Explore, Plan, Code, Commit), with the creator's checkpoints and the retrospective. Keep it as `.vibe/plans/01-<short name>.md` and follow it exactly.
- [Increment template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/increment-template.md): the same workflow for every later change of a published app, in a plan of its own (`.vibe/plans/<NN>-<short name>.md`), on the decisions of the first version.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/AGENTS.md): what always holds in an app repo. The generator writes it into the app.
- [Plan front matter schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/plan-front-matter.v1.schema.json): `archetype`, `phase`, `prePushFailures`.

## Skills

Install them into your harness with `npx skills add lernapps/tooling`. An app commits them; `lernapps update` replaces its `lernapps-*` skills with those of the tooling it moves the app to, and leaves the app's own skills alone.

- [lernapps-app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/SKILL.md): the rules every app follows, each with its id, in files by concern that it links. The [platform rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/references/platform-rules.md) hold for every app, however it is built: give them to a tool that builds without this tooling.
- [lernapps-listing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-listing/SKILL.md): how to open the listing pull request and act on its results comment.
- [lernapps-quiz](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-quiz/SKILL.md): how the quiz works and how to write its questions.
- [lernapps-explainer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-explainer/SKILL.md): how the explainer works: its structure, blocks, formulas, languages, exercises and components.
- [lernapps-interactive](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-interactive/SKILL.md): the principles of an interactive app's code, and what of its archetype is not built yet.
- [lernapps-content-research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-content-research/SKILL.md): what the app teaches: the curriculum, with the Lehrplan as orientation for grade and order, the competencies as "Ich kann …" grouped into chapters, second sources verified by opening them. For every archetype.
- [lernapps-exercise-patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-exercise-patterns/SKILL.md): exercises from shared data files, patterns written down once and varied, and a component or an issue for the rest; with a [catalogue of patterns by subject](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-exercise-patterns/references/patterns.md).
- [lernapps-content-growth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-content-growth/SKILL.md): how an app grows after its first version, one competency per slice, with a brief for parallel sub-agents.

Every app from the generator also has its own content guide, `.agents/skills/app-content/SKILL.md` (linked for Claude Code as `.claude/skills/app-content`): the skeleton the assistant fills in once the plan is confirmed. Where it is filled in, it takes precedence over the skills above.

## Rules and schemas

- [Rule catalog](https://lernapps.net/tooling/rules/): every rule by id, with scope, severity and where it is told and checked. Check messages link to `https://lernapps.net/tooling/rules/#<id>`.
- [Validation report](https://lernapps.net/tooling/schemas/validation-report.v1.schema.json): what `lernapps check` reports, in YAML.
- [Question bank of a quiz](https://lernapps.net/tooling/schemas/quiz.v1.schema.json): `src/quiz.json` of an app from the archetype quiz.
- [Content of an explainer](https://lernapps.net/tooling/schemas/explainer.v1.schema.json): the YAML files in `src/` of an app from the archetype explainer.
- [Review verdict](https://lernapps.net/tooling/schemas/verdict.v1.schema.json): what the review agent judged, in YAML.
- [Catalog entry](https://lernapps.net/apps/schemas/entry.v1.schema.json): the entry of an app in the catalog, owned by lernapps/apps.

## Review procedure

Before an app is listed, the owner has an agent in a fresh context review it.

- [Prompt](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling/blob/main/review/prompt.md): what the review agent does, step by step.
- [Rubric](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling/blob/main/review/rubric.md): the items for every app, each headed by its rule id.

## Archetypes

An archetype is a kind of app: a template, a runtime, skills and the rules in scope.

- quiz: questions with options and feedback; the assistant writes only the question bank. [Template](https://github.com/lernapps/app-templates/tree/main/quiz), skill lernapps-quiz, [rubric](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling/blob/main/review/archetypes/quiz.md).
- explainer: chapters of pages that explain and practise, readable without JavaScript; the assistant writes the content as YAML, and Vue components only where no block fits. [Template](https://github.com/lernapps/app-templates/tree/main/explainer), skill lernapps-explainer, [rubric](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling/blob/main/review/archetypes/explainer.md).
- interactive: one app page plus a static start page. Skill lernapps-interactive, rules and [rubric](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling/blob/main/review/archetypes/interactive.md); not in the tooling yet.

## Optional
